title: Waymo Las Vegas robotaksi hizmetini başlattı
summary: Waymo, otonom taksi filosunu Las Vegas'ta hizmete sundu. Filoda Jaguar I-Pace ve Zeekr üretimi Ojai modelleri yer alıyor.
body:
Waymo otonom taksi hizmetini Las Vegas şehrinde resmen başlattı. Carscoops'un aktardığına göre, şirketin sürücüsüz araçları ay başından bu yana mobil uygulama üzerinden çağrılabiliyor.

## Las Vegas filosunda hangi araçlar var?

Şirketin diğer şehirlerde de kullandığı Jaguar I-Pace modellerinin yanı sıra, Las Vegas'taki filonun çoğunluğunu Çin'deki Zeekr tarafından üretilen elektrikli Mix minivan tabanlı Ojai modeli oluşturuyor. Araçlar, altıncı nesil Waymo Driver teknolojisiyle yollara çıkıyor.

## Güzergahlar ve ilgi

Başlangıç aşamasında otonom taksiler Boulder Junction'dan The Strip üzerinden Sahara Avenue'ya kadar hizmet veriyor. Ayrıca Spring Valley ile Winchester arasında da bağlantı sağlıyor. Waymo'nun açıklamasına göre, hizmet başlamadan önce 100 binin üzerinde kişi robotaksi filosu için ilgi göstermişti.

**Neden önemli?** Las Vegas belediye başkanı Shelley Berkley, bu adımın şehrin akıllı ve temiz ulaşım seçeneklerini genişlettiğini belirtti. Yoğun kalabalıklar ve hareketli sokaklarıyla bilinen şehirde, tamamen elektrikli otonom taşımacılık güvenli ve modern bir ulaşım alternatifi sunuyor.

source_texts.title: The City That Never Sleeps Now Has Taxi Drivers That Don’t Need To Sleep
source_texts.summary: Sin City is perhaps the perfect location for Waymo to launch its robotaxi platform
source_texts.text:
- Waymo has launched its robotaxi fleet in Las Vegas with the I-Pace and Ojai.
- The majority of Waymo’s Las Vegas robotaxi fleet will include Zeekr’s Ojai.
- More than 100,000 people have expressed interest in the Las Vegas robotaxi fleet.
In Las Vegas, the city that never sleeps, where many locals and tourists love to have a big night out on the town, there’s now a new robotaxi service available thanks to Waymo. No more worrying that your taxi driver has spent the evening gambling away their life savings before picking you up.
Starting earlier this month, Waymo’s advanced robotaxis can now be ordered through the company’s app. As in other cities, the fleet will include Jaguar I-Pace models, but as is the case in Denver and San Diego, the majority of Waymo vehicles operating in Las Vegas will be the Ojai model, built by Zeekr in China and based on the electric Mix minivan.
Waymo says that before launching its service in Las Vegas, it had received expressions of interest from more than 100,000 people interested in the robotaxis coming to Sin City. As part of the initial roll-out, the self-driving taxis will operate from Boulder Junction up the Strip to Sahara Avenue. They will also connect from Spring Valley to Winchester.
“Las Vegas and its neighborhoods are evolving rapidly, and expanding smart, clean transit options is essential for our city’s future,” Las Vegas mayor Shelley Berkley said. “The public rollout of Waymo’s all-electric autonomous ride-hailing brings technology directly to our municipal streets, helping residents and patrons travel seamlessly between the cultural districts and neighborhood centers. By investing in cleaner, safer urban mobility, we ensure the City of Las Vegas remains an accessible, vibrant, and forward-looking community.”
Waymo has spent months analyzing roads across Las Vegas to ensure its vehicles, powered by the sixth-generation Waymo Driver, are up to the task. In a city like Las Vegas, where the flashing lights, crowds, and wild drivers can distract even the most experienced motorists, cruising around in a Waymo will probably become the choice of transportation for many.
